latin: Quamuis in anima ita sit actu natura intellectualis per quam cum angelo conuenit, sicut est natura rationalis per quam ab eo distinguitur, nihil tamen intrinsecum est in ea, per quod possit sine propria specie aliquid a se distinctum intelligere.
latin_note: 1486 punctuates 'distinguitur. Nihil' as beginning a new sentence; sense unaffected.
translation: The soul does actually possess an intellectual nature by which it agrees with the angel, just as it possesses a rational nature by which it is set apart from the angel; even so, nothing intrinsic to it lets it understand anything distinct from itself without a proper species of its own.
